TECH COMPASS · SITE INFORMATION

Privacy notice

Updated 2026-10-19

Tech Compass is an individual-operated website run by Saxon Crawford in Kentucky, United States. This notice describes the current site. It is a draft pending a review of hosting-provider retention and applicable privacy requirements.

Reading and searching

Tech Compass does not add advertising, analytics scripts, tracking pixels, contact forms, or browser storage. Guide search and suggestions run in your browser against a downloaded article index. Search terms can appear in the URL, browser history, and hosting request logs. Avoid entering passwords, account numbers, or other sensitive information into search.

Hosting and access

The site is delivered through OpenAI Sites. Hosting, network-security, and access providers may process connection information such as IP addresses, browser details, requested URLs, timestamps, and authentication data to deliver and protect the service. This private release requires access through the hosting platform. The application's lack of tracking does not mean the hosting platform processes no data.

Email contact

If you email Saxon Crawford, your email address, message, and any attachments are handled by the email services involved, including iCloud Mail for the contact address. Send only information needed to explain your question. Do not send passwords or unnecessary personal information. The site itself has no message database or email submission form.

Cookies and links

The Tech Compass application does not set cookies. The hosting platform may use its own access or security mechanisms. Links to documentation and other websites lead to services with their own privacy practices. Clicking an email link opens your email application; no message is sent until you send it.

Questions and requests

Contact Saxon Crawford using the email link below for privacy questions or requests concerning information you have sent directly. Applicable rights and the handling of a request depend on the information and relevant law. Provider-specific processing and retention periods are still being reviewed; this notice does not promise a retention period that has not been established.

Email Saxon Crawford
